items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: "In January 1925 Paul Howard came into the band for a short period, replacing Charlie Mosley and giving the drummer at the time as Ben Borders. A year later trombonist Luther Graven commenced working with Clay."

ctx.x: around here or where he is since that. He brought his Chinee wife and ever' body back--all his kids.

"In January 1925 Paul Howard came into the band for a short period, replacing Charlie Mosley and giving the drummer at the time as Ben Borders. A year later trombonist Luther Graven commenced working with Clay."
And Ivie Anderson was working with Clay at the Vernon Country Club. Ivie worked around town a lot as a single...
